title: DESCRIPTION
source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS:*

* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student.(ID-1407, 1445)
* Distributed the Q/A for today Exam.
* Verified a Transfer certificate.
* Correction & printed the Transfer certificate (ID-3059)
* Formatted  the SCIENCE question paper for grade 9 & 10 for the MID-TERM Retest Exams.
* Printed the SCIENCE question paper for grade 9 & 10 for the MID-TERM Retest Exams.
* Verified the few National School Games Bonafide certificate.(approx-06)
* Uploaded & updated the student's (Birth , Aadhar, & Caste certificate) on the Eduletics portal.(approx-11)
* Updated the Excel sheet with the Grade IX registration data.
* Updated the teachers data from the Oasis 7.0 portal (approx 18).


*OTHER WORK*

* Dispersal Duty.
* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
* Collected homework feedback from the first-floor classes and shared it via a Google Form.
